senses.gloss: m. (Germanus, v. preced. art.) German, one of the Caucasian race, white man, opp. כּוּשִׁי.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86:3">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> everywhere you find <he>ג׳ מוכר כושי</he> one of the white race sells a dark man.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:5:4">Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ</cite> top <he>ג׳ עבדיה וכ׳</he> a German, a slave of &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:8">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>גרמניא</he> (corr. acc.); Y. Ab. Zar. II, end, 42ᵃ <cite ref="C01363"><he>גרמנא</he></cite>.
